title: The Impact of Factors That Affect Performance of Projects of Construction Companies in Portugal
content: This study aims to analyze the impact of factors that affect the performance of construction company projects in Portugal. To achieve the objective set, throughout the literature review, we sought to identify the factors that affect the performance of projects by Portuguese construction companies. Meanwhile, a sample of 218 Portuguese construction companies was collected. From this perspective, the quantitative research technique and method was adopted. The results achieved were based on structural equation modeling, pointing out the high correlation between the three first-order constructs (external environment, time/delay, project financing). Financing is one of the factors that negatively influence the impact on the performance of Portuguese construction projects, statistically confirmed in this study through hypothesis H3. On the other hand, hypothesis H1 was confirmed: the external environment has a relationship with the impact on the performance of projects in Portuguese construction companies. Finally, it was found that hypothesis H2 corroborated the study. The time/delay factor does not positively affect the impact on the performance of projects in Portuguese construction companies. It should also be noted that the impact of factors that affect the performance of construction projects may vary according to the environment in which the construction projects are located
